Callout.Name: Jackknifed Lorry
Callout.Message: Articulated lorry jackknifed across the carriageway.
Callout.Advisory: Driver out and unhurt, carriageway blocked both ways.

Script.Line: The trailer is across both lanes and the cab is in the barrier.
The driver is out and he is walking about. He is shaken.
Nobody is getting past. That is the top and bottom of it.

Lines.Approach: It is across both lanes and the driver is out. Nobody is hurt, everything is stuck.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
